video_title: Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady React to LaMelo Ball to the Timberwolves & Kawhi's Return In Toronto

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's growth and maturity after being benched in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: There was a lot of talks about him being moved last year, year before.
quotes.quote: There was a lot of talks about him being moved last year, year before. Particularly when he got benched. We talked about it on TV a lot when he got benched, and that's where we started to hear a lot of noise about it, but then he bought in and things changed and then they made the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's maturity and health during his best season
quotes.excerpt: This past season was his best season in terms of how many games he played.
quotes.quote: They had a good run last year, they play in. They had a good run last year where I think they took another step of maturity and LaMelo was the lead of that. This past season was his best season in terms of how many games he played, like he was healthy for that season. If you look at his play, he kept the same style of play but he kind of dialed it back in terms of it was controlled. It was controlled to where he got other guys involved and they got the possessions that they needed for them to improve as a team, so that started with him.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Praise for the coaching staff's willingness to bench star players
quotes.excerpt: I thought their coach did a great job of not being afraid to bench a player.
quotes.quote: I thought their coach did a great job of not being afraid to bench a player of his caliber because he, and we always talk about this like when we watching the playoffs, hey man, James Harden stinking it up, bro. Sit him down. We talked about this with, sit him down. I like this coach so much because he's not afraid to make those moves and in return, it actually elevated his player in their team, so you got to make some hard decisions as a coach, as an organization sometimes. I'm glad he did that because it paid off for them.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's impact and offensive evolution on the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Now I think you're adding another level for him to be dangerous on the offensive end.
quotes.quote: What I look at Rudy Gobert, to me, he was grabbed the offensive rebounds, put backs, that's cool. He's good at rebounding, he's great at defense, but now I think you're adding another level for him to be dangerous on the offensive end, setting the pick and rolls and rolling to the basket and now you got a 6'8" point guard who has great vision and passing ability that can set up these lob threats for him and now you got Anthony Edwards on the perimeter with a live dribble playing against a rotating defense. That is a dangerous situation for him, boy.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Concerns about the Timberwolves' interior presence after roster changes
quotes.excerpt: Is it enough? I mean, you lose Naz, you lose Julius.
quotes.quote: Is it enough? I mean, you lose Naz, you lose Julius, and I'm saying that more so for offensive foul power. You did bring back I-O, I-O but I'm talking about as far as in paint presence and big fellas. Like do you have enough there? Yes, you have guard play. You have a big guy that you could throw in the post and give it to Naz Reid or sometimes you can say what you say what to say about Julius Randle, but there's you can also give him that ball down the post and he going to beat up somebody down there and get you in the penalty.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels' defensive and offensive value to the team
quotes.excerpt: You got Jaden McDaniels, defensively, offensively, like he, I think he's going to give you a little more.
quotes.quote: You got Jaden McDaniels, defensively, offensively, like he, I think he's going to give you a little more. Can he get, can he get, every now and then, you got to, you had a big guy that you could throw in the post and give it to Naz Reid or sometimes you can say what you say what to say about Julius Randle, but there's you can also give him that ball down the post and he going to beat up somebody down there and get you in the penalty. It's, I mean, we've seen it, that sometimes he goes left, but at the end of the day, you can, seriously, but you can give him the rock and do something. I feel you lose that, you know, because every now and then, okay, that's the case, I I want to see Anthony Edwards post up a little more. I think they need a guy that they can put down in the post every now and then.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Disappointment in Julius Randle's playoff performance last season
quotes.excerpt: I hate how he played last year in the playoffs because he's so much better than that.
quotes.quote: I hate how he played last year in the playoffs because he's so much better than that and he played like that because I think he was in his feelings because he was in the trade talks, because that's not Julius Randle, bro. Like what we saw, what we covered, that ain't Julius Randle, bro. Like you so much better than that, but, you got to be, again, you got to stay professional. I don't care what the case is, what the case may be. You got to stay professional, especially when you have a good team like that that's very capable.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The value of a veteran mentor for Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: A mentor and a veteran in the locker room at all times that he can lean on.
quotes.quote: A mentor and a veteran in the locker room at all times that he can lean on, look out for him and always be in his corner, like hey, I don't recommend that, or whatever the case may be and hold him, hold him accountable and I feel like Ja now will go out there and don't want to let Ja Morant down because of what Ja means to the NBA as well, so I am interested to see what that looks like and I think we going to see a unreal version of Ja Morant.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The positive influence of professional teammates on Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: My duo, I'm going LaMelo and Ant-Man, dog.
quotes.quote: My duo, I'm going LaMelo and Ant-Man, dog. I'm going LaMelo because you know LaMelo is very entertaining, he's flashy, and then Ant-Man, what, you know, what he brings to the table with the the swag, the the the the the the cut, huh? Both of them, swag. Both of them, swagged out and I just think the two together, man, it's just going to be fun to watch, very exciting. They going to be, they going to be going at dudes next on that basketball court and talking shit, doing it, taking names. I just think the the excitement that we going to see from both of them is going to be something, you know, special to watch this year.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Hopes for LaMelo Ball's continued commitment to all aspects of the game
quotes.excerpt: I hope that LaMelo will still buy into all aspects like continue to buy in.
quotes.quote: I hope that LaMelo will still buy into all aspects like continue to buy in at all facets of the game and aspects of the game on and off the court because now you on, I mean, you were in Charlotte where you created a a very good team that was very capable of being in the playoffs. You're going to a Minnesota team that, that is what they do. That's what they do. They defend, they go out there and score, you going to obviously heighten them offensively. Can you add to what they do defensively? So I'm really interested to see, uh, what that duo looks like because yeah, if you talking about flash and all the stuff that you, the intangibles that you just talked about, oh, yeah, you going to get a lot of that.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on the Toronto Raptors' 2019 championship run
quotes.excerpt: Toronto showed up and showed out during them playoffs, boy, you hear me.
quotes.quote: Toronto showed up and showed out during them playoffs, boy, you hear me. Hey, Toronto was so live around that time, dude. The man delivered the championship in 2019, we saw it. We saw it, we saw how crazy Jurassic Park was. Toronto showed up and showed out during them playoffs, boy, you hear me. Hey, Toronto was so live around that time, dude.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Predicting a 50-win season for the Clippers with their current roster
quotes.excerpt: You don't think with a team with Scottie Barnes, RJ, and freaking Kawhi Leonard, 50?
quotes.quote: We haven't talked about them about 50 wins. You don't think with a team with Scottie Barnes, RJ, and freaking Kawhi Leonard, 50? They can't 50? That's going to be a 6th team. You talking about with 50 wins. I told you the East was going to be a problem this year, bro. It's going to be a problem this year. And you going to have to, you going to have to win 50 games.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential for a balanced and competitive Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: We could possibly have six teams in the East and I'm saying this like, uh.
quotes.quote: We could possibly have six teams in the East and I'm saying this like, uh, but like it's it's been a while since, you know, we we talk about the wild West and how strong it is. We could possibly see balance on both coasts where it's, I mean, it's real strong. One to six is real strong.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Houston Rockets and Toronto Raptors as playoff contenders
quotes.excerpt: Toronto might not be a top four seed and I see Houston and Toronto neck and neck.
quotes.quote: Even with the teams like Houston, I like them, but when I look at, I'm going to take Toronto. Toronto might not be a top four seed and I see Houston and Toronto neck and neck, because of Kawhi. Kawhi brings and adds a different dynamic and elevates his team to a level that competes with Western Conference teams that are the Houstons, your, who else give me another strong team, not San Antonio, OKC, but Dallas, Lakers, Phoenix.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The need for Devin Booker to have a reliable scoring partner
quotes.excerpt: I just wish we could see a board Booker with somebody like Cade Cunningham.
quotes.quote: I just wish we could see a board Booker with somebody like Cade Cunningham where all he got to do is just give a look at a bucket. Just get buckets.
